cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Declare Allegiance
cards.instruction: Make someone choose which person, side, or claim to authority they will support.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. For the workshop move, are you backing my proposal or Morgan's?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Fine. Whose proposal will you call that in the meeting?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: And when Morgan and I both claim you supported us, which one will you correct?

mechanism: A copies an apparent allegiance signal, learns it means something else, and pressures B to make a real unambiguous choice.
confusable: D55 recruits a coalition; D58 demands which side B backs even when B prefers a compromise.
comparison: Workshop proposal credit versus personal election ribbons.
seedUse: Preserve compromise attribution and vote-day timing as partner-created pressures.
